name: Support moteur Turbo bionique — cage et enveloppe souple PicoGK
description: Two occurrences in the Turbo PET group, position 21. Open cage with curved branches and forked roots; separate compliant envelope, necked and sculpted with six lobes. No rectangular base and no solid cup wall. This morphology does not reconstruct the OEM mechanism and predicts neither stiffness nor damping; no optimisation under load has been carried out.

classification.intended_use: Shape study and documentary assembly only; no engine support or vehicle installation is authorised.

sources.title: Porsche PET 993, groupe 109-00 Turbo
sources.notes: Identity and quantity from the PET requirements already reviewed in the repository. Years 1995–1998: Turbo scope studied; exact application by model year to be confirmed. No OEM illustration or geometry copied.
